notes: Analyzed kernfs/sysfs write plumbing (termination guaranteed at fs/kernfs/file.c:296-346: kmalloc(len+1)/prealloc(len+1) and buf[len]='\0'). Automated scan of all *_store* functions in s01 for own-copy/memcpy(count)+string-parse patterns; deep-read nvme dhchap, target alua/configfs, scsi_sysfs, versal_edac candidates.

candidates.reason: core_alua_store_tg_pt_gp_info: count>TG_PT_GROUP_NAME_BUF(256) check is off-by-one; count==256 fills whole buf[256] via memcpy, no terminator slot; strstrip->strlen and strcmp scan past stack array end.
target_dev_alua_lu_gp_store: same off-by-one bound (count>LU_GROUP_NAME_BUF(256)) allows memcpy of 256 bytes into buf[256]; strcmp(strstrip(buf),"NULL") on unterminated stack buffer.
kernfs_fop_write_iter: kmalloc(len+1) (line 306) and buf[len]='\0' (line 318); prealloc_buf = kmalloc(len+1) at line 673; writes capped at PAGE_SIZE/atomic_write_len.
sysfs_kf_write/sysfs_kf_bin_write pass the kernfs-terminated page buffer directly to ops->store/battr->write; no additional copy or terminator loss.
nvme_ctrl_dhchap_secret_store: kzalloc(count+1) then memcpy(dhchap_secret,buf,count); byte at index count stays 0 -> NUL-terminated before strcmp/nvme_auth_generate_key.
nvme_ctrl_dhchap_ctrl_secret_store: identical kzalloc(count+1)+memcpy(count) pattern; terminator slot exists.
store_shost_state: strncmp(name,buf,len) short-circuits at kernfs buf[count]='\0' before buf[len] is evaluated; buf[len] read only when len<=count, inside PAGE_SIZE+1 buffer.
store_state_field: same strncmp+buf[len]=='\n' pattern, safe due to kernfs trailing NUL and short-circuit evaluation.

inject_data_ue_store: len=min(count,sizeof(buf)) with char buf[6]; buf[len]='\0' writes buf[6] (1-byte stack OOB write) when count>=6. File-based (debugfs-style) write handler, not a sysfs ->store; belongs to the debugfs branch; not fully audited here.
synth_store flagged by automated memcpy(count)+string-parse scan; not deeply read in finalize phase.
